metadata.ablation: freeze first live plan; no further model calls

plan.reason: At 24/100 evaluations with 5 stagnant steps and no recent improvement, the surrogate is still data-poor, so auto selection lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic rather than committing early. current_to_best operator balances exploitation of the incumbent with DE differential diversity, suited for a 5D bounded landscape. Exploration is raised to 0.6 to break stagnation via novelty in standardized predicted-objective-minus-distance acquisition, while local_fraction 0.4 and radius 0.15 (normalized) keep a meaningful share of candidates in refined local search without over-concentrating. Population 30 and generations 5 cap surrogate generations per cycle to conserve the fixed true-evaluation budget, leaving room for iterative updates as more data arrives.
